findings.location: Paragraph beginning "“Oh, that’s far. Mother won’t let us walk on the road at all,” added Micah." (children's dialog where child's name appears)
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or transliterate the name Micah correctly as माइकाह (or माइका) consistently throughout the translation. Replace माइकल with माइकाह in every occurrence.

findings.location: Paragraph: "We skipped along, watching the dust swirl beneath our feet on that warm summer morning. ... through the gully, over the rippling creek, and up the steep hill"
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original sense: translate 'rippling creek' as तरंगित नाला / हल्की लहरों वाला नाला / फिसलता नाला, whichever best fits the style. For example, replace 'जर्जर नहर' with 'तरंगित नाला' (or 'हल्की लहरों वाला नाला').

findings.location: Paragraph: "The Rhine family had an old man living in their summer house."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate 'summer house' into Hindi rather than leaving the English transliteration. Suggestion: replace 'समर हाउस' with 'गर्मियों का घर' or 'ग्रीष्मकालीन आवास' as fits the tone. Use the same term consistently.
